title: MontuPython Desktop
tagline: Astronomical ephemerides for the ancient world
paragraphs: MontuPython (mnṯw 'app(y)) is a Python package to compute astronomical ephemerides in the ancient world — thousands of years before the present. It was developed for ancient Egypt and applies equally to other sites of cultural and archaeoastronomical interest.

MontuPython Desktop is the graphical front-end to that library. It offers pre-built tools for users who do not wish to program at the Python level, or who want quick access to core functionality. Open a module from the sidebar — for example, Calendar Calculator to convert among Julian/Gregorian, proleptic Gregorian, caniucular (Egyptian civil), and Julian Day formats.
